method: Source-attributed windows and dated specimens, drawn at calendar-year resolution. These bands are not proof of exact physical die introduction/withdrawal. Some are manufacturer eras, others are photographed/gallery coverage or separate renewal pieces. Serial transitions, older stock and class-specific overlap remain independent of calendar bands.

windows.label: McClary · porcelain issue
windows.note: 1913 and 1914 numeral variants remain separate in the model; the manufacturer does not certify identical physical dies.

windows.label: MacDonald · lithographed tin
windows.note: 1916 through 9000; Tacey overrun 9001–9342 occupies the same calendar year. This is printed lettering, not an embossed die era.

windows.label: Tacey · tin overrun / 1917
windows.note: 9001–9342 overrun, then 1917. Coat-of-arms variants do not independently prove a different numeral alphabet.

windows.label: Tacey · first embossed steel
windows.note: Source relates the dies to Washington 1918–20 tooling. Renewal tabs and smaller legends have independent lettering.

windows.label: Tacey · slanted oval / scroll
windows.note: Reappears under Oakalla in 1931–32; separate dates are not necessarily cut from this serial alphabet.

windows.label: Tacey · straighter dies
windows.note: 1930 is a separate one-year Thompson issue; it is not included merely because a model profile label once spanned 1928–30.

windows.label: Thompson · one-year issue
windows.note: Separate serial and province-lettering components; no same-year non-passenger identity is inferred.

windows.label: Oakalla · reused slanted family
windows.note: Same broad slanted family comparison, not certification of every physical tool. Early trailers retain their independent upright small-format letters.

windows.label: Oakalla · straighter family
windows.note: The leading bar on four-digit numbers is a layout/punctuation feature. Province and date stamps stay independent.

windows.label: Oakalla · slimline slanted family
windows.note: The source describes 1938 tooling copied closely from 1937. Similar contours need not be the identical physical tools.

windows.label: Oakalla · rounded passenger family
windows.note: 1951 strip and 1953/54 tabs belong to independent small lettering lanes; cross-class serial comparisons need their own support.

windows.label: Oakalla · new machinery / block family
windows.note: Province lettering changes in 1964 with older long dies recurring. A shared manufacturer is not sufficient to merge compact motorcycle tooling.

windows.label: Oakalla · 1970 passenger base
windows.precision: base context; decals not manufacture dates
windows.note: Old plates may survive into later renewal dates; this band is the documented base-production context.

windows.label: Oakalla · 1973 passenger base
windows.note: Ham-radio and commercial classes retain their own overlap and legend/date reuse exceptions.

windows.label: ACME · Quebec-style passenger family
windows.note: 1979 base continues the 1978-style family. Crisper/sloppier paint blocks alone do not define a new alphabet.

windows.label: Hi-Signs · Nova Scotia-style passenger family
windows.precision: around ARX-999; same base overlaps ACME
windows.note: This does not transfer the passenger serial transition to industrial, logging or other classes.

windows.label: Astrographic · flag-base production context
windows.precision: subtypes coexist; later exceptions not bounded by this band
windows.note: Male/female, neoprene-top, non-passenger and Classic observations cannot all receive exact start/end dates from this broad band. Neoprene production reportedly retained the same male dies.

windows.label: Waldale · short passenger trial
windows.precision: documented run; not the main contract start
windows.note: Trial appears alongside Astrographic production; date labels alone do not settle a specimen’s die.

windows.label: Waldale · principal passenger contract
windows.precision: November 2002; ongoing end is current catalogue coverage
windows.note: Principal transition 999-HFK / 000-HGA, with early HFE and late Astrographic JFG–JFK exceptions. End 2026 means ongoing catalogue coverage, not factory withdrawal.

windows.label: Motorcycle · compact Astrographic context
windows.note: Compact tooling is kept separate from full-size passenger profiles; exact subtype transitions remain unconfirmed.

windows.label: Motorcycle · compact Waldale context
windows.note: The 2011 redesign increased lettering 3/8 inch at S59-000. End 2026 is catalogue coverage, not tooling withdrawal.

windows.label: Utility trailer · Astrographic specimens
windows.note: Overlaps the source’s 2002–16 Waldale gallery; exact serial handover is unresolved.

windows.label: Utility trailer · Waldale specimens
windows.note: A model preset labelled 2000–2016 cannot make the entire period Waldale manufacture.

windows.label: Collector motorcycle · first Waldale observation onward
windows.note: Earlier first batch B8-0001–B8-5000 is Astrographic. The passenger Collector mid-B54 transition has no forced calendar date.

windows.label: Long province legend · documented passenger use
windows.precision: documented use; possible earlier use is not plotted
windows.note: Older long province dies recur unpredictably in 1964 and on late 1973 commercial plates. This band does not assert introduction in 1955 or withdrawal in 1963.

windows.label: Long province legend · 1964 coexistence
windows.note: Long and short legends appear even on the same registration number. Serial alphabet and province legend are independent.

windows.label: Passenger province die on late commercial base
windows.basis: source-explicit component reuse within a base
windows.precision: base period, not exact stamping date
windows.note: 970000 and 30000–39999 overrun; 1968/69 passenger 19 date tool also appears in 980000/990000. These serial windows are more precise than calendar inference.

windows.label: 1951 · separately issued renewal strip
windows.note: Strip lettering is independent of the 1950 base serial and base date.

windows.label: 1953/54 · separately issued side tabs
windows.note: Small tab dates and retained 1952 base date are independent components.

windows.label: Lieutenant Governor arms · 2003 photograph label
windows.note: An older arms specimen is labelled 2003. Its introduction date is not established by this photograph; the model’s 1998 start is approximate.

windows.label: Lieutenant Governor crest · 2008 design replacement
windows.precision: design announcement, not withdrawal of every older plate
windows.note: The crest replaces the arms design in 2008, but the source also labels an older arms photograph 2016. Both design histories can overlap in service.

windows.label: Lieutenant Governor arms · 2016 photograph label
windows.note: Old arms are still shown by the source in a 2016-labelled photograph after the crest’s 2008 replacement. This supports overlap and prevents an assumed universal 2008 withdrawal.

windows.label: Vancouver · blank centennial base · 1986 label
windows.basis: dated source specimen / visual component comparison
windows.precision: specimen/decal labels, not manufacture or tooling lifespan
windows.note: Screened words visually support Frankfurter Std Medium as the model match, with Vancouver 100 artwork on the blank base. Historical font identity and full lifespan are unconfirmed; the blank has no embossed number or decal.

windows.label: Vancouver · for-hire · 1995 decal label
windows.basis: dated source specimen / visual component comparison
windows.precision: specimen/decal labels, not manufacture or tooling lifespan
windows.note: Screened city/category words, embossed serial and renewal decal are independent components. The decal covers the underlying Vancouver 100 emblem. A 1995 decal does not establish manufacture or introduce the typeface.

windows.label: Vancouver · taxi specimens · 1996/1997 labels
windows.basis: dated source specimen / visual component comparison
windows.precision: specimen/decal labels, not manufacture or tooling lifespan
windows.note: Photographs label taxi 1071 in 1996 and 254 in 1997. Their embossed municipal serials are independent of the screened Frankfurter-style words. Green and blue bands are observed alternatives, without a year-to-colour rule or shared provincial tooling claim.

windows.label: Prince George · city vehicle · 1959 label
windows.basis: dated source specimen / visual component comparison
windows.precision: specimen/decal labels, not manufacture or tooling lifespan
windows.note: The specimen supports wide upper city words, taller narrower VEHICLE and rounded serif date/serial constructions. The date and serial share a model reconstruction; maker, complete numeral accuracy and physical tooling identity remain unconfirmed. Bicycle tags are a separate cohort.

windows.label: Prince George · city vehicle · 1962 label
windows.basis: dated source specimen / visual component comparison
windows.precision: specimen/decal labels, not manufacture or tooling lifespan
windows.note: A distinct photographed layout has date above, a single city line, small serif number and spaced VEHICLE. Its damaged edge is not reproduced. Model component reuse supports comparison, not proof of the same maker, physical tools or a 1962 transition.

events.label: Passenger Waldale handover
events.note: Main contract from November 2002; early HFE and later Astrographic JFG–JFK exceptions.

events.label: Collector passenger handover
events.note: No calendar date is forced onto this class-specific serial boundary.

events.label: Commercial flag-base handover
events.note: Astrographic and Waldale production coexist on the same design.

events.label: Farm truck handover
events.note: Class-specific estimate; not the passenger 2002 boundary.

events.label: Restricted vehicle handover
events.note: Transition bracket only; do not assign a manufacture year from a later decal.

events.label: Motorcycle lettering enlargement
events.note: 3/8 inch enlargement; compact alphabet identity still needs photographed comparison.

events.label: Reduced trailer prefix begins
events.note: Prefix lettering is smaller than the number and separate from BC/date stamps.

events.label: Mixed motorcycle dies
events.note: Different glyph types coexist on individual plates; the year does not determine a uniform alphabet.

events.label: Lieutenant Governor crest and older arms coexist
events.note: The arms model begins approximately 1998 and covers the 2003/2016-labelled source examples. The crest model begins 2008. These are design/use and photograph labels; exact production and individual manufacture dates remain unconfirmed.
